name: Still working
when: Taking longer than expected, still on it

variants.name: Coffee
variants.desc: Takes a sip from a steaming mug, then gets back to it.

variants.name: Push on
variants.desc: Leans into a heavy block and inches it along.

variants.name: Second wind
variants.desc: A sweat drop rolls off, a quick shake, and it is wide awake again.

variants.name: Stopwatch
variants.desc: A stopwatch ticks round overhead; it glances up each lap, then back to work.

variants.name: Long road
variants.desc: Trudges along a road toward a flag that is still a way off.
